About lodge

lodge is revolutionizing outdoor audio with solar-powered speakers that deliver audiophile-grade sound without ever needing a charge. Our lodge Solar Speaker 4 features high-fidelity drivers, all-weather IP66 durability, and innovative solar technology. Over 900 crowdfunding backers validated our game-changing approach to portable audio.

What Makes Us Different

We're the ONLY brand with truly wireless audio - no battery anxiety, ever. Premium audio components deliver crystal-clear highs and deep bass that rivals indoor speakers, while weatherproof engineering means it works anywhere. lodgeLINK™ stereo pairing creates immersive soundscapes that blow competitors away.

How Affiliates Can Earn

High-ticket commissions on a unique product that sells itself! Premium pricing ($300+ range) means bigger payouts per sale. Proven demand from 900+ successful backers shows this isn't just hype - it's a money-making opportunity with passionate customers who love recommending our speakers.

How to Promote Us

Massive target market: outdoor enthusiasts, audiophiles, eco-conscious consumers, and tech lovers. Easy selling points: never dies, sounds incredible, works in any weather. Perfect for high-converting content around camping, parties, poolside relaxation. Premium quality justifies premium pricing - customers happily pay for reliability.

Other Info

American innovation meets crowdfunding validation. We've solved the #1 outdoor audio problem while maintaining uncompromising sound quality. Strong warranty and customer satisfaction mean fewer returns and more referrals. This product practically sells itself to anyone tired of dead speakers!
